title: Freedom Tower Field Trip — Permission Form
intro: Symphony Orchestra performs the opening set at MOAD Freedom Tower on Sunday, October 4 (9:00am–2:00pm). Every high school student needs this M-DCPS parent permission form, filled in and signed by a parent or guardian. Do it right here: answer the three questions, fill in the emergency contact section, sign with your finger, add the date, and send. Due Friday, October 2. College students do not need this form.
